text:
## Training & Awareness  
**Mandatory Training:**
- All customer-facing staff: Annual KYC training
- Compliance staff: Quarterly updates + specialist training
- Managers: Annual policy overview + escalation procedures  
**Training Topics:**
- Document recognition and authenticity
- Acceptable forms of identity/address verification
- Risk assessment
- Escalation procedures
- Regulatory requirements
- Customer privacy

raw_entities.name: Training and Awareness Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy establishing mandatory training obligations for all staff categories, covering KYC procedures, document verification, risk assessment, and regulatory compliance. The policy differentiates training frequency and content by role, with customer-facing staff receiving annual KYC training, compliance staff receiving quarterly updates with specialist training, and managers receiving annual policy overviews with escalation procedures.
context: All customer-facing staff: Annual KYC training
Compliance staff: Quarterly updates + specialist training
Managers: Annual policy overview + escalation procedures

raw_entities.name: Annual KYC Training for Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that all customer-facing staff complete annual Know Your Customer training to ensure consistent application of KYC procedures and document verification standards.
context: All customer-facing staff: Annual KYC training

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Compliance Staff Updates and Specialist Training
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that compliance staff receive quarterly updates supplemented with specialist training to maintain current knowledge of regulatory requirements and compliance procedures.
context: Compliance staff: Quarterly updates + specialist training

raw_entities.name: Annual Policy Overview and Escalation Procedures for Managers
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that managers receive annual training covering policy overview and escalation procedures to ensure effective supervision and incident handling.
context: Managers: Annual policy overview + escalation procedures

raw_entities.name: Document Recognition and Authenticity Training
raw_entities.description: Training topic requirement covering staff competency in recognizing and verifying the authenticity of identity and address documents presented during customer onboarding and verification processes.
context: Document recognition and authenticity

raw_entities.name: Acceptable Forms of Identity and Address Verification Training
raw_entities.description: Training topic requirement ensuring staff understand and can apply the bank's standards for acceptable identity and address verification methods during KYC procedures.
context: Acceptable forms of identity/address verification

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment Training
raw_entities.description: Training topic requirement covering staff competency in identifying, evaluating, and classifying customer and transaction risk to support compliance and fraud prevention objectives.
context: Risk assessment

raw_entities.name: Escalation Procedures Training
raw_entities.description: Training topic requirement ensuring staff understand when and how to escalate compliance concerns, suspicious activities, and policy breaches to appropriate management and compliance functions.
context: Escalation procedures

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Requirements Training
raw_entities.description: Training topic requirement covering the regulatory framework and legal obligations applicable to the bank's operations, customer relationships, and compliance functions.
context: Regulatory requirements

raw_entities.name: Customer Privacy Training
raw_entities.description: Training topic requirement ensuring staff understand customer privacy rights, data protection obligations, and confidentiality requirements in handling customer information.
context: Customer privacy

raw_entities.name: Customer-Facing Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members with direct customer interaction responsibilities who are required to complete annual KYC training and maintain competency in document verification, risk assessment, and escalation procedures.
context: All customer-facing staff: Annual KYC training

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members with compliance responsibilities who are required to receive quarterly updates and specialist training to maintain expertise in regulatory requirements and compliance procedures.

raw_entities.name: Managers
raw_entities.description: Management personnel responsible for supervision and oversight who are required to receive annual training on policy overview and escalation procedures to ensure effective incident handling and staff guidance.
context: Managers: Annual policy overview + escalation procedures
